title: Carne Asada Burrito with Black Beans and Lime Rice
summary: Skirt steak is marinated briefly in lime, orange, garlic and spices, seared to 63 °C and sliced, then rolled with lime-coriander rice, cumin black beans, cheese, avocado and onion.
equipment: bowl or food bag for marinating

ingredients.item: mild ancho or Kashmiri chilli powder (pure chilli, no added salt)
fine sea salt or table salt
can no-salt-added black beans, drained and rinsed
Monterey Jack or mild Cheddar, grated

steps.title: Marinate the steak
steps.text: Mix the lime and orange juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, chilli powder, salt and oil. Coat the steak, cover and refrigerate 1-2 hours, no longer.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice, then simmer covered with 300 ml cold water on the lowest heat for 15 minutes. Rest 10 minutes and fork through the lime juice and coriander.

steps.title: Warm the beans
steps.text: Sizzle the cumin in the oil for 30 seconds, add the beans and 3 tbsp water and cook 5 minutes, mashing about a third.

steps.title: Sear the steak
steps.text: Pat the steak dry and cook on a smoking-hot griddle 3-5 minutes per side until charred and 63 °C in the thickest part. Rest 5 minutes and slice thinly across the grain.

steps.title: Fill and roll
steps.text: Warm each tortilla until pliable. Layer a quarter of the rice, beans, steak, cheese, avocado and onion down the middle, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast the burritos seam side down for 1-2 minutes to seal. Halve and serve with lime wedges.

tips: Slicing across the grain is what makes skirt steak tender.
Dry the steak well before searing for the best char.
Warm tortillas fold without cracking; cold ones split.
storage: Cool quickly, cover and refrigerate within 2 hours. Eat within 3 days, reheated until piping hot (75 °C in the centre).
